known.title: reopen tells the caller to run reopen again for a plan that was closed before the merge; GitHub never records a new close, so following the message loops forever

writeReopen keeps only the node id from its pre-write read and claims from the stale snapshot, so a plan that another login claimed after the settle-wait snapshot is still reopened, commented on, and claimed
test-contracts runner discovery finds only the node() call for repo-plan-cli and checks only that discovered runners are listed, so removing bun-1 (the fake gh runs on Bun) still passes
no reopen test exercises the refusal 'plan #<n> changed during the settle wait; run reopen again'
the fake gh pullRequest handler returns merged, mergedAt, state, url, and baseRefName whether or not the query selects them, so a helper query that omits a field still passes
reopen.test.mjs asserts that the request arguments do not contain addAssigneesToAssignable, a wiring test of request text rather than of the stored outcome
the report-section verify command hashes sed output per file, so files that all lack the section hash empty input identically and still print one line with the full count
